question: The Constitution (One Hundredth One Amendment) Act, 2016 is related to ______.

options.text: reservation of seats and special representation to cease after certain period
establishment of a separate development board for Hyderabad - Karnataka region

solution:
The correct answer is __**goods and services tax.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **GST **stands for** Goods and Services Tax.**
 
• GST was passed as the **101st amendment act**. It came into force on **1st July 2017.**
 
• GST is a comprehensive **indirect tax** on the manufacture, sale, and consumption of goods and services throughout India.
 
• It will** replace existing multiple taxes **levied by the central and state governments.
 
• The concept of GST was first introduced in the Parliament by **P. Chidambaram in 2005.**
 
• **France** is the first country to introduce GST
